name: First launch requires monthly and yearly limits
description: Verifies a first-time user must enter both positive limits before reaching the planner and that setup is remembered.
steps: Enter a monthly limit of 18000 and yearly limit of 200000
expected: The dashboard opens after both limits are saved, and the setup screen does not appear again after refresh.

name: Edit monthly and yearly limits in settings
description: Verifies both spending limits can be edited from Settings and persist after reload.
steps: Set monthly budget to 15000 and yearly budget to 180000
Close Settings and refresh the app
expected: The monthly limit shows ₹15,000 and yearly limit shows ₹1,80,000.

name: Add and complete a task
description: Verifies a task can be created, completed and remains completed after refresh.
steps: Open Today and add a task named 'Read chapter'
expected: 'Read chapter' remains visible with its completed state.

name: Record and filter an expense
description: Verifies an expense is saved with its category and payment method and can be found in the transaction list on a narrow screen.
steps: Add an expense of 125 in Food with note 'Snack' and payment method UPI
expected: The Food transaction Snack appears with ₹125.00 and UPI without horizontal overflow.

name: Reject invalid limits and empty task title
description: Verifies invalid spending limits and empty task titles are rejected.
steps: On first launch, enter 0 for the monthly limit and 100000 for yearly limit
Open Add task and leave its title empty
expected: Invalid limits do not dismiss setup; an empty task title is rejected without adding a blank task.
